entries.997e04f5a1974185: With the theme of the medium-term management policy "Innovation into a Produce Company," the company is advancing transformation into a "human resource-type business" that develops and creates in-house products and services aligned with consumer needs. In its core businesses, it sets out: in the video-related business, redefining the business area from "film" to "video entertainment"; in the food and beverage-related business, expanding manufacturing capacity through construction of a central kitchen for the yakitori specialty store "Kushitori" and expanding revenue in the ready-made meal business; and in the used condominium renovation and sales business, creating a structure to stably realize purchase and sales volume of about 300 units per year.
